content: शारीरक {%a.%} (-की|{%f.%}) .²1 Relating to the body, corporeal; पश्यत्ययं धिषणया ननु सप्तवध्रिः शारीरके दमशरीर्यपरः स्वदेहे <ls>Bhāg. 3. 31. 19</ls>. .²2 Incorporate, embodied (as the soul). .{@-कम्@} .²1 The embodied spirit. .²2 The inquiry into the nature of that spirit (a term applied to the Bhāṣya of Śaṃkarāchārya on the Brahma-sūtras).
